thin: ID recovery is the thinnest category: no City of Mesa, Maricopa County or state page lists ID help (Mesa's homeless resource list has none), 211 Arizona returned no results for Mesa, and findhelp refused to load. The only lists are the Homeless ID Project's own site list and two small community pages, which between them name four providers; Scout's own search has to do the work here (e.g. MVD, SSA, ADHS fee waivers, shelters' ID help).
